headline: Two calls today, Evan and luca. Robert showed yesterday with no outcome logged. This is the week that decides August.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Run Evan Makris and luca bayati with proof pre loaded, then log both outcomes the same day. Close out Robert Gutierrez: he showed yesterday and his row still says Talking with no result. Two ticks fix the tracker disagreement: put Y in Booked for Joshua Haber and rahul, both were genuinely booked, and the sheet undercounts without it. The EUR 5,000 still needs its Payments row.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Cash: EUR 5,000 of 30,000 with 11 days left, and today is the month's biggest swing. Close rate 40 percent MEASURED against the new 35 percent floor, on 5 shows, gate just met. Volume 37 yesterday, day six of main account only while account 2 warms.
